item.tib: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i thugs sgrub kyi mngon rtogs nyi ma'i snying po pa'i snying po
item.coloph: de ltar thugs sgrub bskyed lugs bzhir gsungs pas/ nang gi bsnyen sgrub tshul gyi bskyed lugs 'di/ log rtog chu 'dzin dri mas ma gos par/ rgyud gzhung dgongs don nyi ma'i snying po dag don gnyer slob mas yang yang nan bskul bas/ thos chung blo rmong khyung btsun bdag gis sbyar/ nyes 'gal rig 'dzin bka' srung gnyan la bshags/ dge mchis bstan 'gror phan pa'i rgyur gyur nas/ bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin rig 'dzin sku thob shog/
